description: Read one form's operational settings — how it submits, what the success state says, where it redirects, notifications, saved progress, response limits, and trust policy (submitMode, submitLabel, successTitle, successMessage, redirectUrl, showProgress, notifyEmail, notifyEmailIncludeAnswers, notifyEmailAnswerFields, notifyEmailReplyToField, sendReceipt, saveProgress, draftAnswersVisible, resumeEmails, resumeUrl, draftDigest, responseLimit, trust). Read these before patching them with fillo_update_settings. Needs settings:manage.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

name: fillo_get_settings
title: Read a form's settings
